The `slugify` function in the repository already works correctly and returns `'hello-world'` for the input `'Hello,  World!'`. 

The issue you described (`'hello---world-'`) would only occur if the regex pattern was `[^a-z0-9]` (without the `+` quantifier) instead of the current `[^a-z0-9]+`. The `+` quantifier ensures that consecutive non-alphanumeric characters are replaced with a single dash.

I've added a test case (`test_slugify_comma_spaces`) to verify this specific input works correctly. All 6 tests pass now.
